correctness.rationale: For each of the 32 orientations of C5, letter-labeled step maps act on subsets of five vertices; a word is in the intersection language iff all 32 reachable endpoint subsets remain nonempty. Exhaustive BFS of the finite product from full subsets closes on 23 non-sink states and one rejecting sink; stable Myhill–Nerode partition refinement has class counts 2,4,7,9,11,13,16,18 and 18 final classes. Independent fresh transition construction matched 24 reachable states and 18 inequivalent states, not just finite tested words. From displayed quotient transition matrix the 27 coefficient zero tests and degree≤26 cross-numerator bound prove generating function (1+z)(1-z²+z⁷)/((1-z)(1-3z²+2z⁴-z⁷)) for every length. Direct triangle and pentagon orientation checks establish separating words 00100/11011. Finite state closure, unlike finite-word enumeration alone, is a complete infinite-language proof.
